Scenario: Login with valid credentials
Preconditions: User account already exists
Steps: Open login page ->Enter valid username -> Enter valid password -> Click login
Expected Results: User should login and reach the dashboard/home page
Actual Results: User successfully logged  in and Products page opened

Scenario: Login with invalid password
Preconditions: User already on login page
Steps: Enter standard_user -> Enter wrong password -> Click login
Expected Results: System should reject login and display an error message
Actual Results: Login was rejected and an error message displayed: Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service

Scenario: Login with empty user name
Preconditions: User  already on login page
Steps: Leave username blank -> Enter secret_sauce in password -> Click login
Expected Results: System should reject login and display username required
Actual Results: Login was rejected and an error message displayed: Username is required

Scenario: Login with empty password
Preconditions: User already on login page
Steps: Leave password blank -> Enter standard_user in username -> Leave password blank -> Click login
Expected Results: System should reject login and display password required
Actual Results: Login was rejected and an error message displayed: Password is required

Scenario: Verify products are visible after successful login
Preconditions: User has valid login credentials
Steps: Login with standard_user -> Observe product page
Expected Results: Products page should open and products should be visible
Actual Results: User successfully logged  in and Products page opened and product page is visible

Scenario: Add a product to cart
Preconditions: User is logged in and product page opened
Steps: Click add to cart on any product -> Open cart
Expected Results: Selected product should be added to cart and visible on cart page
Actual Results: Product was added to cart succesfully and was visible on cart page. The Remove and Checkout buttons were also displayed.

Scenario: Remove product from cart
Preconditions: User is on added to cart page and product is already in added to cart
Steps: Open cart -> Click remove a product from cart
Expected Results: Product should be removed from cart and should no longer be visible on the cart page
Actual Results: Product was successfully removed from cart page and was no longer visible on the cart page.

Scenario: Verify checkout button opens checkout page
Preconditions: User is on added to cart page and product is already in added to cart and user clicks checkout button
Steps: Open cart -> Click checkout button
Expected Results: Checkout page should be opened when a user clicks checkout button
Actual Results: Checkout page opened successfully and displayed fields for First Name, Last Name, and Postal Code, along with a Continue button.

Scenario: Checkout with all field empty
Preconditions: User is on checkout information page
Steps: Click checkout button -> Leave all fields blank -> Click continue
Expected Results: System should reject submission and display an error message.
Actual Results: System rejected the submission and displayed an error message: "First Name is required."

Scenario: Checkout with Last name field empty
Preconditions: User is on checkout information page
Steps: Click checkout button -> Enter First name and Postal Code -> Leave Last name field blank -> Click continue
Expected Results: System should reject submission and should display Last name is required
Actual Results: System rejected the submission and displayed an error message: "Last Name is required."

Scenario: Checkout with Postal Code field empty
Preconditions: User is on checkout information page
Steps: Click checkout button -> Enter First name and Last name -> Leave Postal Code field blank -> Click continue
Expected Results: System should reject submission and should display Postal Code is required
Actual Results: System rejected the submission and displayed an error message: "Postal Code is required"

Scenario: Checkout with valid information
Preconditions: User is on checkout information page
Steps: Click checkout button -> Enter FIrst name, Last name and Postal Code -> Click Continue
Expected Results: System should accept the entered information and open the Checkout Overview page.
Actual Results: System successfully opened the Checkout Overview page and displayed Payment Information, Shipping Information, and Price Total including tax.

Scenario: Complete checkout with Finish button
Preconditions: User is on checkout Overview page
Steps: Review order details -> Click Finish
Expected Results: System should complete the order and should display an order confirmation message
Actual Results: System successfully completed the order and opened the confirmation page. A message was displayed: "Thank you for your order!" along with Back Home and Generate PDF Order buttons.

Scenario: Verify Back Home button after order completion
Preconditions: User is on order confirmation page
Steps: Click Back Home
Expected Results: System should return the user to Products Page
Actual Results: System successfully returned the user to the Products page after clicking the Back Home button.

Scenario: Verify Generate PDF Order button
Preconditions: User is on order confirmation page
Steps: Click Generate PDF button
Expected Results: System should generate or download the order details as a PDF file
Actual Results: System successfully generated the order PDF, and the PDF file was downloaded automatically.

Scenario: Verify product sorting by Price (Low to High)
Preconditions: User is on Products Page
Steps: Click Sorting dropdown -> Select Price(low to high)
Expected Results: Products should be displayed in ascending order based on price
Actual Results: System successfully sorted the products in ascending order based on price.

Scenario: Verify product sorting by Price (High to Low)
Preconditions: User is on Products Page
Steps: Click Sorting dropdown -> Select Price(high to low)
Expected Results: Products should be displayed in descending order based on price
Actual Results: System successfully sorted the products in descending order based on price

Scenario: Verify product sorting by Name (A to Z)
Preconditions: User is on Products Page
Steps: Click Sorting dropdown -> Select Name(A to Z)
Expected Results: Products should be displayed in alphabetical order based on names
Actual Results: System successfully sorted the products in alphabetical order based on names

Scenario: Verify product sorting by Name (Z to A)
Preconditions: User is on Products Page
Steps: Click Sorting dropdown -> Select Name(Z to A)
Expected Results: Products should be displayed in alphabetical order (Z to A)
Actual Results: System successfully sorted the products alphabetically from Z to A.

Scenario: Verify product page is opened after clicking on product name
Preconditions: User is logged in and is on Products page
Steps: Click on a product name
Expected Results: Product details page should open and display information related to the selected product
Actual Results: System successfully opened the product details page and displayed the product information.

Scenario: Verify Back to Products button on product information page
Preconditions: User is on the product information page
Steps: Click the Back to Products button
Expected Results: System should return the user to the Products page
Actual Results: System successfully returned the user to the Products page after clicking the Back to Products button.

Scenario: Verify Add to Cart button on Product information page
Preconditions: User is on the product information page
Steps: Click on Add to Cart button
Expected Results: System should add the selected product to the cart.
Actual Results: System successfully added the selected product to the cart.

Scenario: Verify Remove button on Product information page
Preconditions: User is on product information page
Steps: Click on Remove button
Expected Results: System should remove the selected product from the cart.
Actual Results: System successfully removed the selected product from the cart.

Scenario: Verify cart badge count increases after adding a product
Preconditions: User is on product information page
Steps: Click on Add to Cart button
Expected Results: Cart badge count should increase by 1.
Actual Results: Cart badge count successfully increased by 1 after adding the product.

Scenario: Verify cart badge count decrease after after removing a produc
Preconditions: User is on product information page
Steps: Click Remove
Expected Results: Cart badge count should decrease by 1.
Actual Results: Cart badge count successfully decreased by 1 after removing the product.

Scenario: Verify multiple products can be added to the cart
Preconditions: User is logged in and is on the Products page
Steps: Click Add to Cart on two different products → Open cart
Expected Results: Both selected products should be added to the cart and visible on the cart page.
Actual Results: System successfully added multiple selected products to the cart, and all selected products were visible on the cart page.

Scenario: Verify removing a product from multiple products from cart
Preconditions: Multiple products are already added to the cart.
Steps: Open cart → Remove one of the products
Expected Results: Selected product should be removed from the cart while the remaining products should stay in the cart.
Actual Results: System successfully removed the selected product from the cart, while the remaining products stayed in the cart.

Scenario: Verify continue shopping button from cart page
Preconditions: User is logged in and is on cart page
Steps: Click Continue Shopping button
Expected Results: System should return the user to the Products page
Actual Results: System successfully returned the user to the Products page after clicking the Continue Shopping button.

Scenario: Verify Menu button and Log Out option is Visible
Preconditions: User is logged in and is on Products Page
Steps: Click on menu(three lines) button
Expected Results: System should display log out button
Actual Results: System successfully displayed the Logout option after clicking the menu button.

Scenario: Verify logout functionality
Preconditions: User is logged in and menu is open
Steps: Click on logout button
Expected Results: System should return user to login page after clicking logout button
Actual Results: System successfully returned the user to the login page after clicking the Logout button.

Scenario: Verify Reset App State functionality
Preconditions: User is logged in, menu is open, and at least one product is added to the cart
Steps: Click on reset app state
Expected Results: System should reset the app state and clear the cart data.
Actual Results: System successfully reset the app state and cleared the cart data after clicking Reset App State.

Scenario: Verify locked-out user cannot log in
Preconditions: User is on the user log in page
Steps: Enter locked_out_user in email field -> secret_sauce in password field ->click Log in
Expected Results: System should reject login and display a locked-out user error message
Actual Results: System rejected login and displayed: "Sorry, this user has been locked out."
